title: Buggy update
body:
I like the app and have been using it for some time.

That being said, I’m quite disappointed that the last update has introduced numerous bugs that make the app very difficult to recommend. Bugs such us being unable to see the yearly report because it crashes the app while loading or the overall completion rate being calculated incorrectly because habits are counted starting one day before they were created aren’t huge issues, but still quite annoying.

My biggest problem is with habit completion being seemingly forgotten for random days, despite my streak showing that they were completed in said days. This might be a visual bug, but going back in time I can see that for some days when I had completed all my habits, some are marked as incomplete. I think the most important aspect of a habit tracking app is to track habit completion correctly, as you wouldn’t want to risk users losing streaks of hundreds of days because of a bug. I know you can go back and mark habits as completed after the fact to correct the issue, but this is not only annoying, the app seems to revert them to incomplete after a while anyways.

I feel more care should be given to testing the updates before releasing them. Most of the bugs I’m mentioning, if not all, could have been caught in testing immediately, so I’m quite disappointed in the developers.
